_role: Native-point safety model: 128-point diffusion state, S-C48 safety-geometry branch kept (candidate topology required: the ellipse queries anchor on the selected candidate), no B-spline, no feedback, no inference-time ALM. Loss weights copied from the S-C48 checkpoint config; the six representation-dependent adaptations are documented in models/safety_point_losses.py.

provenance.architecture: current v4 modules: SceneCNN (16x16 single map feature) + TrajectoryEncoder + Safety branch (SkeletonEncoder/MatchBlock/TopologyHead/PathFeatureHead/EllipseGeometry/EllipseShapeHead/SafetyControlFusion) + FinalDenoiser(8 blocks)
provenance.data_source: data/processed/160m-k4p-c48 (same cache S-C48 used; contains curve_gt, candidate_*, ellipse_shape4_gt, alm_cell_*)
provenance.schedule_choice: T=256: the 16-level schedule has sigma_min=8.77 m, which puts a 12.4 m terminal-noise scale under every Langevin-type loop; 256 levels give 1.10 m
